{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-voln","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-z22y: transcript_4 drops CRED_I and uses CIPHERTEXT_3 instead of PLAINTEXT_3 per RFC 9528 §5.4.2","description":"## Summary
Commit 8ac8e5c ('project-LICHEN-worker6-z22y: fix') made two spec-deviating changes to transcript_4:

1. **CRED_I removed from TH_4** — RFC 9528 §5.4.2 requires TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I). This commit removed the `_cred` parameter entirely instead of actually hashing it. Both initiator and responder call sites no longer pass the credential.
2. **CIPHERTEXT_3 used instead of PLAINTEXT_3 at initiator** — At edhoc.rs:907, `plaintext_3` is cloned before `encrypt_in_place_detached` at :912-913, but :917 now passes `&ciphertext_3.0` (which is ciphertext after in-place encryption) instead of `&plaintext_3`. The spec explicitly requires PLAINTEXT_3, not CIPHERTEXT_3.

## Fix Required

### Function signature
`transcript_4` needs 3 params and must hash all 3:
```rust
fn transcript_4(th_3: &[u8; 32], plaintext_3: &[u8], cred_i: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; 32], EdhocError> {
    let mut buf = heapless::Vec::<u8, 1024>::new();
    encode_bstr(&mut buf, th_3)?;
    encode_bstr(&mut buf, plaintext_3)?;
    encode_bstr(&mut buf, cred_i)?;
    Ok(compute_th(&buf))
}
```

### Initiator call (:917)
`transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i)?`
(credential_i is already available from :875-876)

### Responder call (:1345)
`transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &pending.plaintext, peer.credential)?`
(was previously 3-arg but dropped in this commit)

### Test (:1635)
Must use PLAINTEXT_3 + CRED_I and the correct reference test vector from RFC 9529 test vectors (not self-computed).","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:08:42.225946296Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:08:42.225946296Z"}
